items.headline: Miami's 2001 throwbacks lead best Week 8 uniforms in college football
items.description: The Hurricanes are the No. 1 team in the country for the first time in over two decades, and they're honoring the early-2000s glory days with their Week 8 threads.

items.headline: Marcus Stokes has 5 total TDs after halftime, Memphis rallies to beat ECU 34-31 in OT
items.description: — Marcus Stokes was 29-of-43 passing for 320 yards and three touchdowns and added two rushing TDs to help Memphis beat East Carolina 41-34 in overtime on Thursday night.

items.headline: Ryder Burton rallies UAB to 30-17 come-from-behind victory over East Carolina in OT
items.description: — Ryder Burton threw a 6-yard touchdown pass to Rod Robinson II in overtime and Delvon Gulley followed with an 80-yard interception return to wrap up UAB’s come-from-behind 30-17 victory over East Carolina on Thursday night.
